elements.text: The scenarios you are about to see are a little different from the ones you have seen before.Instead of choosing the missing letter to complete the final word, we are going to challenge you to generate your own final word that will complete the story. Your goal is to think of a word that will end the scenario on a positive note. The end doesn't have to be so positive that it no longer seems possible, but we want you to imagine that you are handling the situation well.
